verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a broad, API-first Core API covering the main program objects. That includes users, businesses, card products, card creation, card state transitions, velocity and authorization controls, transactions, disputes, webhooks and sandbox simulations, and Marqeta markets these as 'open APIs'. However, no evidence describes the UI (dashboard) or states that every UI action has an API equivalent, so parity is implied rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a dashboard-to-endpoint mapping, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration of full coverage.
